column1: # GPU appraisal guide. One physical line per key; use literal \n for line breaks.

column2: A graphics processing unit (GPU) renders images and performs parallel matrix calculations. This guide explains how to inspect its basic attributes and working condition.
A GPU's working condition depends on its contacts, core and power connector.
Any of these problems makes the GPU unusable.
GPU performance consists of compute power and energy consumption:
-Actual compute = Rated compute*(Underclocked memory count*0.8+Normal memory count*1)/15\n  -Actual power = Rated power*8/Power module count
A GPU cannot be used if its core does not match its model.
